name: ticket-printer
title: Ticket Printer
description: Your last deploy on a train ticket hanging out of a printer, stamped OK. Hover and it feeds out the tickets before, perforated and curling a little more under their weight. A new deploy prints live, line by line in the jerky steps of a thermal head, gets stamped, and the ticket below tears off along the perforation; a failed build prints in red. TicketPrinterLive polls an endpoint returning { source, project, deploys } (see /api/recent-deploys in the docs, backed by Vercel or GitHub Actions).
